title: Species conservation projects
quote: Project Tiger began with 9 reserves in 1973; India now has 58

items.what: **5** new national projects incl. gharial, GIB, Olive Ridley

boxes.title: Project Tiger & NTCA
items: Start: **9** reserves, **18,278 sq km**; now ==**58** in **18** States==
**NTCA**: **2006** amendment to WPA; chaired by **Union Environment Minister**
Largest TR: **NSTR** (**5,443 sq km** core, Nallamala)
Tigers **2022**: **3,682**; about **70-75%** of world's wild tigers
Estimation every **4 years**: camera traps, **M-STrIPES**
**TX2**: double tigers by **2022**; Tiger Day **29 July**

boxes.title: Project Elephant
items: **33** Elephant Reserves in **14** States
Covers **captive** elephants too (⚠ not only wild, UPPSC 2017)
Herd leader: ==**female**== (UPSC 2020); gestation about **22 months**
**National Heritage Animal**: **2010**; India has **60%** of Asian elephants
**MIKE** = elephants (CITES); **M-STrIPES** = tigers
AP: **Koundinya** WLS; **Rayala** Elephant Reserve

boxes.title: Big cats & IBCA
items: Cheetah extinct in India **1952**; Kuno got **12** from **South Africa** (2023)
Purpose: restore **open forest and grassland** (APPSC 2022)
⚠ Source is **Namibia**, not Nigeria; Asiatic cheetah only in **Iran**
**IBCA**: **April 2023**, **Mysuru**; **7** big cats; HQ ==**New Delhi**==, not Geneva
Global Tiger Forum: **1993**, New Delhi
Lion second home: **Barda WLS** proposed

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: National Aquatic Animal = ==Gangetic dolphin==, not Olive Ridley (APPSC 2019)
IBCA: open to **96** range countries; HQ Geneva is false (APPSC 2024)
Ranjitsinh case subject = **GIB** (APPSC 2024)
Recovery Programme: **22** CR species; CAMPA funded, **5** years (APPSC 2019)
Hope Spots: **Lakshadweep**, **Andaman and Nicobar** (APPSC 2024)
